This file passes. CreateTaskUseCase does the normal job of an application-layer use case. It receives a request DTO and loads the project through the ProjectRepository port, failing if the project doesn't exist. It then builds a TaskEntity, saves it through the TaskRepository port and maps the result to a response DTO. It has no persistence code, no transport or HTTP handling and no framework logic; storage goes through injected domain interfaces.

Two small points are borderline but not enough to fail. First, the ID is created inline with Math.random(), which could live behind an ID-generator port. Second, the initial status 'todo' is passed in from here, when the entity could set that default itself. Both are common in use-case code, so they are not clearly misplaced responsibilities from another layer.
